widgets_values: A striking poster for "CODE OF THE SAMURAI" captures the duality of tradition and technology through a powerful visual contrast. On the left side, a traditional samurai warrior in full, ornate armor stands poised and resolute, his face partially obscured by a helmet, holding a gleaming katana at his side. The scene is rendered in a sepia-toned, historical style, evoking the elegance and solemnity of ancient Japan. On the right side, a sleek, futuristic cyborg warrior emerges from the shadows, his glowing blue optics piercing through the darkness, clad in advanced, metallic armor that reflects the light. This figure is depicted in a cool, modern, digital style, emphasizing speed, power, and innovation. The two warriors are positioned back-to-back, separated by a shimmering, translucent energy line that pulses with a soft, ethereal glow, symbolizing the convergence and tension between past and future. The title "CODE OF THE SAMURAI" is boldly displayed in a font that seamlessly blends traditional Japanese calligraphy with modern digital elements, rendered in metallic silver and centered horizontally across the poster where the two styles meet. Below the title, the tagline "HONOR IS TIMELESS" appears in a smaller, clean white sans-serif font, subtly placed at the bottom center to reinforce the theme. The layout masterfully highlights the clash and fusion of ancient traditions with cutting-edge technology, creating a visually dynamic and thematically rich poster.

《武士密码》的电影海报，以过去和未来的戏剧性二元性为特色。**左图**：一位传统的武士，身穿复杂的全套盔甲，手持一把抛光的武士刀，象征着坚忍的荣誉。这件艺术品使用了深褐色的色调和纹理细节，唤起了旧世界的历史氛围。**右图**：一个未来主义的半机械人战士，有着发光的蓝色光学，光滑的金属盔甲和增强的控制论，散发着技术的精确性。风格是现代的，冷蓝色和银色的色调让人联想到数字未来。**中心分隔**：两个人物背靠背站立，由一条发光的、脉动的能量线分开，柔和地发光，象征着时代之间的紧张与和谐。**标题位置**：“CODE OF THE SAMURAI”以混合字体突出显示，混合了传统的日本书法笔画和尖锐的金属数字边缘，呈现在反射银中，水平居中。**标语位置**：在标题下面，标语“荣誉是永恒的”出现在一个极简主义，白色无衬线字体。**背景**：从左边的温暖、朴实的色调到右边的冷、工业色调的渐变增强了对比主题。通过微妙的灯光效果、阴影和纹理叠加创造深度，确保动态的、视觉上引人注目的构图。
